Needs changes before merge.

Requested before merge:

1. `assets/posts/richauto.cps:209`: Include the operation name in each coolant refusal. The current warning omits it. `startSectionBody()` clears `opName` at line 260 before it calls `coolantCode()`. I reproduced this through the CLI with operation `ReviewCoolantOp` and a Flood entry that states `M7`. The only warning was:
   ```text
   warning: RichAuto DSP A11 flood coolant requires M8, got M7
   ```
   The warning must identify the operation, as required by `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, “The machine is truth.” Add a regression test with a unique operation name. The existing name `A11` also occurs in the controller name.
2. `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs:55`: Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record its lanes and results in the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “Heavy lanes at review,” requires this before readiness. The body states `Heavy lanes: not run`. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects every app heavy target because this registry file changes: 205 planned steps. A dry run is not a test pass.

The post tests cover clearance, unsupported operations, drilling, arc planes, origin translation and the block format. No existing golden changed. I read all 24 new goldens line by line.

Local verification used the trial merge with upstream/main `62353ac753947eba162538e0d9305ad86858cfb3`. No GitHub runner was used.

- Quick gate: **762 of 764 steps passed**. Both build steps passed. Two app suites failed, as listed below.
- Clippy: passed for `camcraft-post` and `camcraft-app`, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`.
- Heavy and light lanes: not run.

Extra suites run:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post --test script_richauto` | 41 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test recorded_streams` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test comment_escape` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |

I repeated two recorded mutations with CLI assertions. All mutation scripts and evidence stayed under `/tmp`. Repository source was unchanged.

- Remove the final `%`: RED on the final-line assertion; the original script then passed and matched the committed arc golden.
- Add spaces between words: RED on the compact-block assertion; the original script then passed and matched the same golden.

The two gate failures also failed on unchanged upstream/main `62353ac75` in a control run. They occur before RichAuto posting. They are base failures, not changes introduced by this PR. Readiness still requires a green gate.

- `crates/app/tests/blind_slot.rs:142`, `blind_slot_pocket_family_cuts_from_end_wall_to_stock_edge`: 3 passed, 1 failed.
  ```text
  assertion `left == right` failed: Adaptive2D
    left: 1
   right: 0
  ```
- `crates/app/tests/corner_relief_safety.rs:177`, `adaptive2d_spiral_and_offset2d_support_relief_while_trochoidal_and_do_not_touch_refuse`: 2 passed, 1 failed.
  ```text
  adaptive2d dogbone verify must be silent: [StrategyFallback { at: 2, areas: 1 }]
  ```

Both failures repeated on the trial merge and on the base. The other five extra suites passed.

Nonblocking notes: `posting_files.rs` grows from 418 to 421 lines. `conformance.rs` grows from 512 to 520 lines. Both already exceeded 400 lines. No controller test ran; the body records the unconfirmed A11 behavior.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both review findings on new head `351ad1a98b44608dfb5c504ba4a765ed2f899391`.

1. **Operation name in coolant refusals (`assets/posts/richauto.cps`):**
   - Added `coolantOp` and `coolantWho()` and prefixed all three `fail(...)` calls in `coolantCode()` with `operation <OperationName>: `.
   - `onParameter()` now sets `coolantOp` from `OperationName`, and `onSectionEnd()` clears both `opName` and `coolantOp`.
   - Pin: `richauto_safety::coolant_refusals_name_the_operation` in `crates/post/tests/richauto_safety/mod.rs` checks all coolant refusal paths with unique operation names (`ReviewCoolantOp`, `UnstatedFloodOp`) plus multi-section isolation.
   - Mutation check: reverting `assets/posts/richauto.cps` made `coolant_refusals_name_the_operation` fail RED; restoring the fix passed all 42 tests in `script_richauto` GREEN.

2. **Heavy lanes (`crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`):**
   - Ran `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` (against `upstream/main` `64b737729`) on final head `351ad1a98b44608dfb5c504ba4a765ed2f899391`.
   - Lane selected: `app heavy: every target` (`crates/app/src/posting_files.rs` changed) — **205 of 205 steps passed, 0 failed** (wall 31.0 min), including `app heavy: conformance`, `app heavy: example_catalog`, `app heavy: solid_law_goldens`, and the 4 expected known-fail steps (`#1950`, `#2849`).
   - Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): **752 of 753 steps passed** (wall 50.8 min), including `script_richauto`, `comment_escape`, `recorded_streams`, `conformance`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `solid_law_goldens`, `coolant_air`, and `coolant_followups`. The 1 failing step is pre-existing `app suites: slot_dxf_sketch` (`a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size`) on base `dfbe0d8a5` (#3293).
   - Clippy (`cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean.
   - Goldens: re-ran `conformance`, `recorded_streams`, `example_catalog` (debug and release), and `solid_law_goldens` on final head `351ad1a98b44608dfb5c504ba4a765ed2f899391`; no existing golden changed.
   - Note: `gh pr edit` failed with GitHub's GraphQL `projectCards` deprecation error in `gh 2.46.0` (and `gh api --method PATCH` is disallowed in this environment), so the PR body could not be updated automatically and the heavy-lane results are recorded here.

Please re-review.

Needs changes before merge. Keep `needs-rework` and `conflicts`.

Earlier findings:

1. **Fixed: operation names in coolant refusals.** Commit `351ad1a98` keeps `coolantOp` after the operation comment clears `opName`. The new `richauto_safety::coolant_refusals_name_the_operation` test passes. It checks unique operation names, all coolant refusal paths, the default coolant ask, and section isolation. All 42 RichAuto tests pass.
2. **Fixed: missing heavy result.** The [author's response](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3294#issuecomment-7087422085) records 205/205 steps on this head. I also ran the heavy gate locally: **205/205 steps passed, 0 failed**. Upstream changed covered code after the recorded base, so I did not rely on that older run alone.

The earlier `blind_slot` and `corner_relief_safety` failures do not repeat on the PR head. Those suites pass 4/4 and 3/3 tests.

Requested before merge:

1. **NEW blocker: a failing quick step**, `crates/app/tests/slot_dxf_sketch.rs:159`. `a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size` fails against `slot_dxf_outline.cl`. The suite has 3 passed tests and 1 failed test. The committed golden has `HSMW-CL v1`, with 9 moves. The generated path has `HSMW-CL v2`, with 15 moves. The failure is:
   ```text
   assertion `left == right` failed: golden .../crates/app/tests/golden/slot_dxf_outline.cl is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test
   ```
   This is the known base defect from #3293. [NeoTech's comment](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3293#issuecomment-7075176143) names its fix in `f4b351682`, through PR #3285. Current main has the corrected v2 golden. This PR head still has v1. Bring in that upstream fix and obtain a green quick result. The earlier review tested a merged tree. The current merge conflicts forced this review to test the PR head, which exposes the old golden. This is a verification blocker, not a defect introduced by the coolant fix.
2. **Merge conflicts:** `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs:55`, `crates/app/tests/conformance.rs:68`, and `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs:308`. The first two files conflict with the Mach3 additions. The last file conflicts with the text-post and native-refusal counters. Resolve these conflicts in the author refresh. Keep both post registrations and the current comment-test coverage.

Local verification used `.claude/worktrees/review-3294`. The attempted merge with upstream/main `74ea8988d800f00d41547ec9d292077d2bc3ddc5` failed in those three files. I aborted it without resolving code. All results below are for PR head `351ad1a98b44608dfb5c504ba4a765ed2f899391`, not a merged tree. No trial-merge commit exists, so there is no merged `HEAD^1` to validate. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **752/753 steps passed**, 1 failed; 50.5 minutes. Both crate builds passed. The only failed step is listed above.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: **3/3 steps passed**; 2.9 minutes. Both motion light tests passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **205/205 steps passed**; 38.9 minutes. The selected lane was `app heavy: every target`. The four known-fail checks for #1950 and #2849 matched their expected failures.
- `cargo clippy -j 32 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Extra suites run, included in the quick gate:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post: script_richauto` | 42 passed |
| `camcraft-post: recorded_streams` | 12 passed |
| `camcraft-post: comment_escape` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app: conformance` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app: solid_law_goldens` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app: example_catalog` | 33 passed, 2 ignored |
| `camcraft-app: example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| `camcraft-app: example_catalog_edge_work` | 1 passed |

This is a safety-tier review. I read all 24 new goldens line by line. The body lists all added programs and refusal files. No existing recorded NC or CL file changes.

I repeated two of the PR's mutations through the local post CLI. Each mutation used a script copy under `/tmp`:

- Remove the final `%`: RED on the final-line assertion. The original script then passed and matched the committed arc golden byte for byte.
- Add spaces between words: RED on the compact-block assertion. The original script then passed and matched the same golden byte for byte.

No controller test ran. The body records the unconfirmed A11 behavior. The source tree is unchanged. The review worktree, target directory, and `review-3294` branch remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: both findings from the latest review.

1. Imported the upstream v2 correction for `crates/app/tests/golden/slot_dxf_outline.cl` through a merge of current main.
   Pin: `slot_dxf_sketch::a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size`.
   Restoring the old golden made the pin fail (RED, exit 101). Restoring the correction passed (GREEN, exit 0).
2. Resolved the three additive conflicts. Kept RichAuto and Mach3 registrations, embedded scripts, conformance entries and extensions.
   Kept the text-post and native-refusal counters and all comment assertions.
   Pins: `conformance::every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles`, `conformance::every_builtin_declares_its_controls_file_extension`, and `comment_escape::header_notes_use_each_shipped_dialect_and_keep_the_full_surface_bound`.
   Omitting the RichAuto registry entry made its pin fail. Changing the text-post count from 22 to 21 made its pin fail.
   Both mutations returned RED (exit 101). Restoring each fix returned GREEN (exit 0).

New head: `e276e36058733af7c0fae58bffaa8898bbb16922`.
Base: `35e3bd173d084c73c6fb3e6819a0247b7060dcb5`.

- Quick: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` — 795/795 steps passed; 48.3 minutes.
- Heavy: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` — 212/212 steps passed; 31.4 minutes. Lane: `app heavy: every target`.
- Clippy: passed: `cargo clippy -j24 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` (1 minute 6 seconds).
- Catalog and golden suites passed in the final quick gate. No golden file changed during the tests.

The initial quick run passed 794/795 steps. Its only failure was `mcp_setup_moves`, and the isolated repeat failed too.
Current upstream supplies its correction in `1c6002baa` through PR #3603. The test now checks creation order after undo.
The final merge includes that correction, and the final quick gate passes.

Please re-review. The worktree remains in place. The PR remains a draft.
